description:
Overview
Site Location: 28 Denham Crescent, Mitcham, Surrey, CR4 4LY. Area located at the back of the rear garden. 
Development Proposal: Demolition of existing independent garage structure and erection of a 2 bedroom residential dwelling, including the creation of private outdoor amenity space, accessible only by the proposed development and within the exiting site boundaries. 

Specific Works Proposed
Demolition: Removal of existing garage structure. Hand demolition techniques proposed to minimise noise, dust and debris. Proposed 70% recycling target for demolished materials where suitable.

New Construction:Proposed structure to comprise of two floors of living spaces spanning the ground and loft floor. 

Ground Floor: 
Open-plan living, dining, and kitchen area with private garden access. Designed with accessibility compliance in mind, with the scope to include further augmentations in relation to access of the loft floor. 

Loft Floor: 2 bedrooms and a bathroom within the integrated roof space, x6 dormer roof lights, x2 standard vertical windows per bedroom allowing a considerable amount of natural light to enter the spaces. 

Building Specifications
Height: Maximum 1.5 storeys respecting local scale. Ground floor internal height - 2227mm. Loft floor internal height - 2000mm
Materials: Multi-stock brick facade matching main house and neighbouring properties, clay tiled or GRP finished roof covering. Installation of uPVC double glazed windows with white or anthracite grey frames

Footprint: 35m2 gross internal area x 2 over both floors - floor area Significantly reduced from previous application to minimise site impact.

Use and Purpose
Use: Self-contained residential dwelling subordinate in size, scale and massing to existing main property,   specifically designed to accommodate the client's mother-in-law

Use Classification: Use to remain within its exiting (C3 Use class) of Single-family residential dwelling. No formal change of use required.

Accommodation: Fully independent and self contained two-bedroom dwelling with complete facilities including kitchen, bathroom, living areas and outdoor amenity space.

Key Development Features
Accessibility: Ground floor fully accessible with step-free access, 900mm+ door widths, and 1.5m turning circles for mobility equipment. Proposed staircase will be constructed with additional accessibility provisions in mind.

Parking: Dedicated off-street parking space (5.5m x 2.4m) with the inclusion of 7kW EV charging infrastructure to be located at the forecourt of main dwelling.

Environmental Enhancements: Maintained soft landscaping, retention of existing 12.7% biodiversity net gain (exceeding 10% requirement). 56% of the proposed schemes site area (46m²) of 82m²) has been retained/as soft landscaping. Sustainable drainage systems including soak-away is also included within the design. A native planting scheme and hedgerow creation is proposed as detailed on the plans.
